# `mise bootstrap mise-shell-activate apply`

- **用法：** `mise bootstrap mise-shell-activate apply [-n --dry-run] [-y --yes]`
- **效果：** 修改状态
- **源代码：** [`src/cli/bootstrap.rs`](https://github.com/jdx/mise/blob/main/src/cli/bootstrap.rs)

Write mise activation into the configured shell startup files

## Flags
- **`-n --dry-run`** — Show what would change without changing anything
- **`-y --yes`** — Skip the confirmation prompt
- **`-h --help`** — Print help
